me fall in love with my
mind

blocks.text:
1. I stopped talking down
to myself

You don’t realize how
negative your thoughts
are until you start paying
attention.

I used to criticize every
move, every feeling, every
flaw. Now I talk to myself
like someone I love.

Gentle. Patient. Honest.

2. I started romanticizing
boredom

Every time my mind got

reach for my phone or
create fake drama just to
feel something.

Now I welcome silence

land.

calm my brain

Not for weight loss. Not to

reconnect. Some days I
walk. Some days I lift. But

remember I’m not stuck —
I’m alive.

4. I stopped oversharing

I used to tell people
everything just to feel
seen. But not everyone
deserves access to your
process.

Privacy is peace. Mystery
is power.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

was okay

There’s something freeing

Healing started when I got
honest with myself — not
performative, not pretty,
just real.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

Just sit and feel what I
usually avoid. The
sadness. The fear. Even
the joy.

Because you can’t love
your mind if you’re always
running from it.

Your future family is depending on you.
Here’s how to become the man you
needed growing up.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Build Discipline.

Discipline is the foundation of every
great life. You don’t need motivation.
You need consistency. Wake up early,
stick to your goals, and show up every
single day, whether you feel like it or
not. It’s gonna suck for a while, but I can
tell you it’s well worth it because
discipline turns boys into men.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Handle Your Emotions
Like a Leader.

I know a lot of men in our lives either
explode in anger or hide when things get
tough. We cannot end up like them. We
need to learn to stay calm under pressure.
Deal with your problems head-on. Being a
man isn’t about being emotionless. It’s
about controlling your emotions, not
letting them control you.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Protect Your Mind.

The man you needed wasn’t wasting time on
garbage content. Stop filling your brain with
TikToks and meaningless distractions. Read
books, listen to podcasts, and consume
content that helps you grow. I use the Blokd
app that comes with a physical card to lock
social media. I leave the card in another room
so I can’t open these apps while I’m working or
trying to read. What you feed your mind
becomes your reality.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Take Care of Your Body.

The man you needed wouldn’t let himself
fall apart. Hit the gym. Eat clean. Stay
active. A strong body builds a strong
mind, and a weak body makes you easy
to break. You owe it to your younger self
to stay healthy and strong.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Stop Seeking Validation.

The man you needed didn’t care what others
thought. He cared about doing what’s right.
It’s hard to break out of the mold in the
beginning. But you’ll feel so much better once
you do. Stop chasing approval from people
who don’t matter. Make decisions that align
with your values and goals, not someone
else’s expectations. The only validation you
need is your own.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

No man is perfect. But the great

man your younger self would look
up to. He’s waiting for you. Don’t
let him down.

a waste of YOUR potential. Focus on leveling
up your life, and the right people will come
naturally. Build yourself first. Love
comes later.

possession because it really is.The way people

promises you can’t keep. Your word is your
currency. Spend it wisely.

blocks.text:
Comfort Is the Enemy.

Every time you choose comfort, you’re
choosing mediocrity. Growth happens in
discomfort. Waking up early, hitting the
gym, grinding when you’re tired. If your life
feels easy, you’re probably doing it wrong.
Get comfortable being uncomfortable.
That’s where greatness is built.

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
Get Off Your Phone.

Your phone is stealing hours of your life
you’ll never get back. All that bullshit
content we consume is wasted time. When I
realized this I decided to do a dopamine
detox. I used the blokd app and its physical
card to lock all distracting apps. I leave the
card in another room so I can’t open these
apps while I’m working. Now I use my phone
like a tool, not a toy.

blocks.text:

If you find yourself making any of these
mistakes, it’s okay. Acknowledge your
shortcomings and learn from them, but
don’t let it consume you. We all fuck up.
Get over it quick so you can get back to
building the life your parents can
be proud of.

don’t have. Learn to block out
distractions and lock in on one thing at
a time. You don’t need to finish 30
things at once. When I used to do that,
I didn’t get anything real done. The
ability to focus is what separates
winners from everyone else.

gets the job done. Train yourself to show up
every day, even when you don’t feel like it. I’d

book that completely changed my routine.
Success is built on boring, consistent effort.

you can master anything.

night before. Prioritize your most
important tasks and cut out anything
that doesn’t serve your goals.
Winners don’t ”find time”. They
make it.

focus. In today’s world, people get stuck

time on ingesting bullshit content. I lock out

energy like your life depends on it,
because it does. The ability to say
”no” is what keeps you locked in.

blocks.text:
things that i learned to eat on a
GLP-1 that sped up
my progress...

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
1. soup became my secret weapon
and u didn’t see it coming

👉 warm liquid with protein and
veggies goes down easier on a slowed
digestive system stomach than almost
anything solid

👉 chicken soup, bone broth with
shredded meat, egg drop soup. all high
protein and gentle

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
2. i stopped avoiding fat and my
results actually improved

👉 healthy fats keep you full longer,
help absorb vitamins and make food
worth eating

👉 avocado, olive oil, nuts, cheese
stayed in my rotation and progress
never stalled

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
3. eat your vegetables cooked
not raw

👉 raw veggies on a slowed digestive
system are brutal and most people
don’t connect the two

👉 raw broccoli, salads, raw pepper. all
harder to break down when your guts
running slow

👉 same vegetable roasted or steamed
go down easie, digest faster and cause
way less bloating

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
4. season your food like your life
depends on it

👉 bland food on a suppressed
appetite is how people stop eating
altogether

👉 your taste buds are shifting. under
seasoned food goes from boring to
unbearable fast

👉 garlic, lemon, chili flakes, herbs, soy
sauce. make food worth showing up
for

items.notes: Full original slide visually inspected. Creator-added captions only; app interface and incidental scene text excluded. Wording, values, punctuation and line breaks checked. Source claims were not fact-checked.

blocks.text:
5. i stopped snacking randomly and
started snacking with purpose

👉 every snack became a protein
delivery system. string cheese, jerky,
nuts, a mini shake

👉 if the snack didn’t have protein, it
didn’t earn a spot in my day

👉 i logged snacks separately in the
DreamMe app and my best days were
always the ones where snacks filled
protein gaps between meals
